clauses.title: CL-D106 records when a record is written
clauses.section: ## CL-D106 — A record is written only for a decision that changes an obligation
requires: A contract record is written for a decision that changes what a gate, the writer, or the driver must or must not do, a cap or budget that bounds what they do included.
A choice that only sets a figure, a path or a wording
as a forward note in that record naming the issue and the owner decision that permitted it ("#nnn later …")
Writing a record for a figure, path or wording choice alone, or recording an obligation change only in an issue thread, requires a new owner decision.
it is recorded in its issue thread and, where an existing record states the value,
Records written before this one are not retired or rewritten by this rule;
Applies to every record written after this one.

clauses.title: CONTRACT.md names when a record is written
requires: A record is written only for a decision that changes an obligation; a figure, path or wording choice is a forward note in the record that holds it (CL-D106).

clauses.title: CL-D34 names the narrowing
requires: CL-D106 later narrowed this: a baseline change alone is a forward note in the record that holds the value, citing the owner decision that permits it, not a new record.
